en.headline: Development Bureau proposes expanding Ta Kwu Ling university town to 75 hectares
en.dek: A paper submitted to the North District Council nearly doubles the campus area and reserves about seven hectares for a second Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts campus.
body: The Development Bureau has proposed nearly doubling the campus area of Ta Kwu Ling university town from 40 to 75 hectares as part of the Northern Metropolis, according to a paper submitted to the North District Council.

About seven hectares would be reserved for a second campus of the Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts, the city’s only public institution specialising in performing arts. The expanded town would cover 10 land parcels along the Ping Yuen River and the Shenzhen River, with shared facilities such as libraries, sports grounds and student dormitories encouraged among institutions.

The priority development area near Heung Yuen Wai is also planned to expand by about 20 per cent to 250 hectares, expected to provide around 13,000 residential units and create 27,000 jobs. Detailed design and construction tenders are scheduled for the first quarter of next year, with land resumption starting in the second quarter of 2028 and first plots ready by 2030 at the earliest.

The Development Bureau said the planning allows flexibility for industry-academia-research collaboration, particularly on parcels next to the Heung Yuen Wai Enterprise Park, while limiting building heights near the central valley to preserve open views.

zh.headline: 發展局建議打鼓嶺大學城擴至75公頃 預留演藝學院第二校舍
zh.dek: 提交北區區議會的文件顯示，校園區面積接近倍增，約7公頃預留予香港演藝學院第二校舍。
body: 發展局向北區區議會提交文件，建議將打鼓嶺大學城校園區面積由40公頃接近倍增至75公頃，屬北部都會區發展一部分。
當中約7公頃用地預留作香港演藝學院第二校舍。擴建後的大學城將涵蓋沿平原河及深圳河的十個地塊，鼓勵院校共用圖書館、運動場及學生宿舍等設施。
鄰近香園圍的優先發展區計劃擴大約兩成至250公頃，預計提供約13,000個住宅單位及創造27,000個就業機會。詳細設計及建造招標預計明年第一季展開，收地工作於2028年第二季啟動，首批土地最早2030年可產出。
發展局指規劃用途具彈性，促進產學研合作，尤其鄰近企業園的校園用地，並限制中央河谷附近建築物高度，以保留開揚景觀。
